arest.description: AREST engine 0.9.0, served by the RUST RESIDENT (arest --mcp): reads, applies (own-table AND absorbed, the stored create:<ft> handlers), orient/cells/query/derive compute natively over the retained sidecar store; the compiler-host verbs (compile/propose/induce/ask, sql and the read long tail) delegate to the same engine's python through cli.py's generic call form — one first-class verb table, two bindings. 28 tools.

arest-legacy.description: The old shell, retained during 0.9.0 interop for the verbs not yet ported: tutor + tutor.* and select_component. WASM mode against its bundled metamodel — the old engine CLI is OUT of the serving path. Everything else: use 'arest' (the new engine).
